name: EngineAI
summary: EngineAI is a Shenzhen humanoid robot maker founded in October 2023 by CEO Zhao Tongyang. Its lineup includes the SE01, PM01 and T800 humanoids.
funding: Seed round in 2024 (about $4.5 million raised by end of 2024, per The Robot Report); Series B of $200 million in April 2026 at about $1.5 billion valuation, per Wikipedia.

sources.title: EngineAI releases PM01 humanoid robot for commercial, educational use
